content.text: Successfully installed and verified the Elterngeldrechner (parental allowance calculator) at /workspace. Followed the guide's mise-based workflow: installed mise (official shell installer, since brew is unavailable on this Ubuntu 22.04 container), ran `mise trust`, `mise install` (all 10 pinned tools incl. node 24.18.0/npm 11.16.0), `mise exec -- npm ci` (566 packages, exit 0). Git hooks: `hk install --global` failed because the container's git 2.34 < required 2.54, so used the hk-documented per-repo alternative `hk install`, which installed pre-commit and commit-msg hooks. Installed wget (required by scripts/generate-app-wrapper.sh) and generated the Familienportal host-page wrapper snapshot successfully. Verification: `mise run static-checks` exit 0 (prettier/tsc/oxlint/stylelint all pass); full vitest suite 5147/5152 passed with 4 pure timeouts from parallel load that all pass when re-run in isolation; `MISE_ENV=staging mise run build` exit 0 producing dist/; `mise run start` serves the widget at http://localhost:5173/ with HTTP 200, the #egr-root mount point, and the correct page title.
